Details 
 The Holmes Hat brings autumn character to a timeless Western silhouette. Crafted from houndstooth twill, this 5-panel ranch hat combines texture and tradition with a faux suede bill for a warm, seasonal touch. A suede die-cut Kimes Ranch horns patch on the front adds depth and authenticity, completing a look that’s both rugged and refined.
 Fit : High Profile | Flat Bill | Adjustable Snapback
 Details : 5 Panel Hounds-tooth Check, Faux Suede Bill, Suede Die Cut Patch
